name: vulos/llmux
description: The LLM multiplexer, embedded locally — one OpenAI-compatible client for every provider.

suggest.openai-php/client: For the Llmux::openai() convenience client pointed at the local gateway
suggest.ext-ffi: For Llmux\Ffi, the in-process C-ABI mode. Needs ffi.enable=1 outside the CLI SAPI; see README.md — the sidecar is the recommended default for PHP.
suggest.ext-pcntl: For examples/fork_probe.php, which demonstrates why the sidecar is the default
